title: Save the Date: NOVAGOLD 2026 Second Quarter Report, Conference Call and Video Webcast
author: Na
description: NOVAGOLD Resources will release its second quarter 2026 financial results on June 24, 2026, followed by a conference call at 8:00 am PT. The company's leadership will discuss Q2 results, Donlin Gold Bankable Feasibility Study progress, and ESG initiatives. All seven shareholder proposals were approved at the virtual annual general meeting, with 74.45% share representation.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is advancing its Donlin Gold project with a Bankable Feasibility Study, achieved strong shareholder approval (74.45% representation with all proposals passing), and demonstrates commitment to environmental stewardship and ESG performance. These indicators suggest operational progress and stakeholder confidence.

title: SAVE THE DATE: NOVAGOLD 2026 First Quarter Report, Conference Call and Video Webcast
author: Na
description: NOVAGOLD Resources will release its Q1 2026 financial results on April 1, 2026, followed by a conference call. The company, along with Donlin Gold Holdings, has awarded engineering contracts to WSP, Worley, and Hatch for key infrastructure work on the Bankable Feasibility Study, and previously selected Fluor as the lead partner for the study.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is advancing its Bankable Feasibility Study through strategic partnerships with major engineering firms (Fluor, WSP, Worley, Hatch), indicating progress on the Donlin Gold project development and demonstrating confidence in moving the project forward.
Selected as the lead partner for the Bankable Feasibility Study of Donlin Gold, representing a significant contract award and recognition of the company's capabilities in major project engineering.
Awarded engineering contract for key infrastructure and unit operations in the Bankable Feasibility Study, representing new project work.

title: NOVAGOLD & Paulson Award Engineering Contracts to WSP, Worley, and Hatch for Key Infrastructure and Unit Operations in Bankable Feasibility Study
author: Novagold Resources Inc.
description: NOVAGOLD and Paulson Advisers have awarded specialized engineering contracts to WSP, Worley, and Hatch for key components of the Donlin Gold project's Bankable Feasibility Study. WSP will design the 215 MW power plant, Worley will engineer the 316-mile natural gas pipeline, and Hatch will design the pressure oxidation circuit and oxygen plant. These contracts complement Fluor's role as lead engineering firm, with work expected to be completed in 2027.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company is advancing a major gold project with significant financing (US$310M raised), assembling world-class engineering teams, and progressing toward key development milestones. The project is positioned as one of America's largest gold mines with 40 million ounces of gold resources.
Selected to engineer the 316-mile natural gas pipeline, a critical infrastructure component, reflecting recognition of their expertise in complex pipeline projects in remote environments.
Selected as lead engineering firm to coordinate and integrate all workstreams for the Bankable Feasibility Study, positioning them as the primary engineering partner for this major project.

title: NOVAGOLD Announces Appointment of Project Director to Lead Advancement of the Donlin Gold Project
author: Novagold Resources Inc.
description: NOVAGOLD announced the appointment of Frank Arcese as Project Director for Donlin Gold LLC, bringing over 40 years of global mining project leadership. Arcese will oversee project planning and execution strategy as the company advances toward launching a Bankable Feasibility Study. The Donlin Gold project, located in Alaska and owned 60% by NOVAGOLD and 40% by Paulson Advisers, is one of the world's largest gold deposits with approximately 39 million ounces of gold.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The appointment of an experienced project director with a strong track record in delivering major mining projects on time and on budget signals progress toward development. The company is advancing the Donlin Gold project toward a critical feasibility study phase, demonstrating operational momentum and strengthened execution capabilities.

title: SAVE THE DATE: NOVAGOLD 2025 Year-End Report, Conference Call and Video Webcast
author: Na
description: NOVAGOLD Resources announced strong results from its 2025 Donlin Gold drill program, delivering high-grade gold intercepts across multiple zones with values up to 26.22 g/t. The company also received a positive decision from the Alaska Supreme Court. Management will discuss these developments and progress toward the Bankable Feasibility Study during a conference call on January 22, 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company reported high-grade gold intercepts from its 2025 drill program and received a positive legal decision from the Alaska Supreme Court, both of which are favorable developments for project advancement and de-risking. These results support progress toward the Bankable Feasibility Study.
